LOWW.notes: Austrian VAT 20% is charged on top of every figure here; the panel holds the net amounts. AIRPORT FEES (17 Nov 2026): Vienna Airport FBO e-mailed an airport fee estimate for A6-AFE (MTOW 45.2 t, 28 Nov - 1 Dec 2026, 7 departing pax, 96 h apron parking). A6-AFE sits in the GL5T group, which was empty at all three handlers, so the group was filled from this document: landing 927.29 (20.5152 per ton on 45.2 t), terminal navigation 333.33, parking 445.08 for 96 h = 4.6363 per hour (111.27 per day), noise charge incoming 7.79 + outgoing 7.79 = 15.58. Airport fees are the same at all three handlers, so landing, navigation, parking and noise were written to FBO Vienna, Magnum FBO and Jet Aviation alike. Weight-independent charges were updated in every group: passenger service charge 20.51 per departing pax (was 20, row renamed from 'Departure Service per pax'), security charge 10.52 per departing pax (was 10), PRM charge 0.86 per departing pax (new row) and the schedule coordination service fee, which the document charges at 0.00 and which is therefore entered as Included (new row). The document's printed net total 1,913.35 does not match its own line items, which add up to 1,944.51; the gross total 2,333.42 equals 1,944.51 x 1.20, so the line items are right and the printed net subtotal is a mis-sum. The panel uses the line items. The GLEX group was deliberately left untouched: its landing 1,044 and navigation 375 are 11% above this document's figures although the weights differ by only 1.7% (46 t against 45.2 t), which weight alone does not explain - to be checked against the next GLEX document. HANDLING (FBO VIENNA): the 2026 price list prices the handling package by MTOW group - Group 1 up to 9 t 360, Group 2 above 9 up to 15 t 530, Group 3 above 15 up to 23 t 820, Group 4 above 23 up to 46 t 1,296, Group 5 above 46 up to 85 t 2,300, Group 6 above 85 up to 110 t 3,610, Group 7 above 110 t 6,400. A6-AFE at 45.2 t falls in Group 4, so GL5T handling is 1,296. The other groups already carried the matching band price and were re-confirmed by this list without change. Magnum FBO and Jet Aviation have not quoted a GL5T handling fee, so theirs stays 'Basic Ground Handling not provided' while their airport fees are filled. Each handler's own service prices do not vary by aircraft group, so GL5T carries the same figures as the other groups at that handler. PRICE LIST CORRECTIONS (17 Nov 2026, FBO Vienna): the 2026 price list carries a single 'communication & admin fee' of 44 per turnaround (22 per leg), while the panel held a Communication Fee of 44 and an Admin Fee of 44 side by side and so charged 88; the two rows were merged into one 'Communication & Admin Fee' - FBO Vienna 44, Magnum 50, Jet Aviation 40. Pushback corrected to 111.50. GPU is listed at 80.25 per started 15 min and the conveyor belt at 123.50 per started 30 min; both rows now carry the hourly figure, GPU 321 and conveyor 247, so that they sit on the same basis as Magnum and Jet Aviation, which both quote 321 and 247 per hour. The package table leaves lavatory and potable water service outside the Aircraft Group 1-5 package (included only for Groups 6-7, and every tail in this panel is Group 3 to 5), so the two rows are no longer 'Included': toilet 366.91 and water 266.10, with waste removal 123.63, entered on the user's figures of 17 Nov 2026 - the price list itself shows waste disposal at 40 and gives no lavatory or water price, so the higher figures are kept on the safe side and the source document is still to be recorded. New tick row: cancellation fee 162 when handling is cancelled within 24 h, outside the basket. Night surcharge changed from 100% to the price list's flat 325 for services outside business hours, window 22:30-06:00; the list closes at 21:00 on Saturday and Sunday, which the panel's single window cannot carry. Not entered, by user decision: valet parking 85 (105 with EV charging), ice cubes 23 per 2 kg, coffee 32 per litre, dishwashing 60 and the city transfers (Mercedes E 57.50, V 69, S 103.50, incl. 10% VAT). The package also carries a 15% discount on all VIP & Business Services. MAGNUM FBO PROFORMA (17 Nov 2026, A6-AFE, MTOW 43.545 t, 28 Nov 15:30 - 1 Dec 13:30 = 70 h, 1 departing pax, total 3,217.15 incl. 15% disbursement): handling 1,328.25 fills the GL5T group and also replaces the rounded 1,328 in the E35L, GLF4 and GLEX groups, which share the same weight band. The combined passenger charge 31.89 matches the panel's 20.51 + 10.52 + 0.86 exactly, and GPU 321 matches as well, which confirms the hourly basis used for FBO Vienna. Changed at Magnum: communication and admin fee 44 (was 50) and the handler now applies its 15% disbursement to that row, so Magnum carries disbAlsoOn for it; schedule coordination 5.40 (was Included, which came from the airport fee estimate where it is charged at 0.00) - FBO Vienna keeps Included; potable water 133.06 and lavatory 183.46 to the cent; out-of-hours charge a flat 472.50 outside 06:00-20:00 local, replacing the 100% night surcharge. Parking at Magnum is 108.98 per started 24 h in the GL5T group, not the airport's hourly tariff, because Magnum parks on its own apron at its own FBO; the other Magnum groups keep the hourly figures until a document gives their daily rate. The noise charge stays in the panel although the proforma has no noise line. Panel against this proforma: 3,265.34 to 3,217.15, +48.19 on the safe side, and the whole difference is landing +19.16, ATC +7.17 and noise +15.58 plus 15% disbursement on those three - landing and ATC because the GL5T group is built on 45.2 t while this flight is 43.545 t. Every other line matches the proforma to the cent. The proforma states the flight type as Commercial although this is a private jet operation; to be queried with Magnum.
